_about: The SDR's inbox (scripts/sdr_inbox.py), Jonathan 2026-10-05: a reply comes in, the drip stops, and a question about times gets two open times read from his calendar; a picked time gets booked. His to edit. "send" and "book" are off: with them off nothing goes to a prospect and nothing is booked for one; a reply is laid in Drafts for him, and on a test thread (he plays the prospect) it is laid in his own INBOX and a quiet hold is put on his calendar. The AIOS never turns "send" or "book" on. "approved" marks each answer he has read and passed; an answer that is not approved is never sent, whatever "send" says. The phrases are plain rules, no model: add a line when a real reply is sorted wrong.
